notes.text: The checked reading בר אחתיה clearly identifies him as Rav Bivi’s sister’s son. Heilprin’s initial rav is retained as a source variant in the note.

The matching counterargument is in collection 51, responsum 2 of the checked edition, in a passage explicitly addressed to the author’s father. The preceding letter treats the title as an office. Distinguish the exchange from Heilprin’s compressed attribution and retain the printed locator.

The Bavli asks whether there were two Yitzḥaks. The author of the reply invokes the uniqueness of the office as an argument about the name. Heilprin’s abbreviated formulation paraphrases that objection.
